data.content_ref: inline:The isolated artifact 084384ac0b1e abstracts the neighbourhood's case-level verification criteria (execution traces, counting queries, injected-false-claim controls) into a single invariant: causal decorrelation of the verifier's verdict from the producer's claim. All concrete operational-independence tests from SRC_002, SRC_003, and SCR_002 are instances of this invariant — they perturb the producer's output and check whether the verdict responds — so the case-level machinery reduces to one covering principle. It is refuted if a concrete case-level test (e.g., the ablation test of SCR_002, or the injected-false-claim controls of SRC_003) provably detects genuine verification while the decorrelation invariant simultaneously declares it restatement, or vice versa, under any well-defined operationalization.
